equipment_id.description: Identifier of the equipment this policy applies to; null for the platform-wide default policy

sustained_excursion_minutes.description: Minutes an out-of-range reading must persist before an alert opens

hysteresis_margin_celsius.description: Margin, in Celsius, a reading must re-enter range by before the alert closes

missed_sync_windows_for_offline.description: Number of missed synchronization windows before a device is considered offline

active.description: Whether this policy is currently active
